Use `make test-fast`. It runs `pytest -m "not postgres" -q`, so it skips the tests marked `postgres`. That matches the project convention stored in EngramDB, and the Makefile confirms it.

To run everything, including the Postgres-dependent tests, use `make test`, which runs `pytest -q`. You'll need a Postgres instance available for that one. I didn't check how the tests connect to it.

I haven't run either command.
